svg.title: C07-M06-F3: Rogue and evil-twin APs and detection
svg.desc: A diagram defining rogue and evil-twin access points and how an approved-AP inventory detects them.
svg.text: C07-M06-F3 Rogue and evil-twin APs and detection
ROGUE AP : unauthorised AP on the network (bypasses controls)
EVIL TWIN : fake AP mimicking a real SSID (lures users)
detection : approved-AP inventory (SSID/BSSID) ; flag anything not listed,
or an approved SSID from an unexpected BSSID (evil twin)
Figure C07-M06-F3. Rogue and evil-twin APs and detection against an approved-AP
